entities.name: Fannessa Fjyorne
entities.description: A Strixhaven student and Oriq cultist on Arcavios, shifting between bubbly and manipulative.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: Student whom Fannessa tried to recruit.

entities.name: Razineth
entities.description: Opponent in the violent match Killian fought.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Group Fannessa serves as an agent.

events.summary: Fannessa gives Killian an empathetic smile during a violent match against Razineth.
events.quote: Fannessa was initially seen giving Killian Lu an empathetic smile during a violent match against Razineth

events.summary: Fannessa offers Killian a drink that suppresses his guilt and enhances his aggression in a duel with Vickus.
events.quote: Fannessa then offered Killian a drink, which suppressed his guilt and enhanced his aggression

events.summary: Fannessa reveals herself as an Oriq agent and tries to recruit Killian.
events.quote: revealing her true identity as an Oriq agent and attempting to recruit him

events.summary: Killian refuses, Fannessa attacks, and he repels her with light magic infusing her with mercy.
events.quote: he ultimately repelled her with his light magic, infusing her with mercy

events.summary: A mage hunter takes Fannessa away.
events.quote: Fannessa was then taken away by a mage hunter

relations.quote: When Killian refused, she attacked him
